prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Memlia accounting blog cover, horizontal 16:9, safe for a centered 1200x630 crop. Premium isometric 3D editorial diorama with simplified geometric objects, matte ceramic and thick blank paper, soft studio light from upper left, short shadows, warm cream paper background #fcfbf7, Memlia green #27b657, deep green #1c8a41 and graphite #231f20. Substantial clear objects readable at thumbnail size, airy coherent composition, consistent with the existing Memlia matte 3D blog covers. No photographic desk scene, no people, no hands, no faces, no human figure, no pawn, no vegetation or scenery, no letters, no readable text, no numbers, no amount, no percentage, no logo, no watermark, no screen, no dashboard, no software interface, no red alert, no automatic sending symbol, no approval seal, no legal or financial certification. No other saturated color. One original wide illustration, no caption. Subject: Organizing the fiscal deadlines of a portfolio without claiming a legal date. A matte geometric calendar block with completely empty cream squares in a deep green frame, several small anonymous cream folders organized on two low green trays, and one graphite placeholder disc resting in a separate review tray rather than on the calendar. No dates, no numbers, no clock, no ticks or approval. Calm pending choice among blank calendar slots.
